title: Elon Musk poker hand (Reel, Dagar Unfiltered)

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: In 2008, Elon Musk played the craziest hand of poker in business history.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: And he was holding absolute garbage.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: SpaceX had launched three rockets. All three failed. One didn't even last a minute.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Tesla was burning cash so fast, it was basically on fire too.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The whole economy was collapsing. And the guy who wants to put humans on Mars was borrowing money from friends to pay rent.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Elon basically said, fuck it, and pushed everything he had left into the middle of the table.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Enough money for one more launch. That's it.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: And holy shit. It actually reaches orbit.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Three months later, NASA calls with a 1.6 billion dollar contract.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The next day, Christmas Eve, Tesla closes a funding round, days before it would've gone bankrupt.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Most people who go all in lose everything.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Elon went all in, and became the first trillionaire in history.
